<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/zones/{zoneId}/aisles"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every Aisle in the given Zone, ordered by SequenceHint then aisle code — that is, in the order an associate would walk them. Answers 404 if the zone itself is unknown. Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.
